prompt.generated_prompt_string: Preserve the face, proportions, and external features of the attached adult model reference when one is provided. Create a minimalist monochrome fashion editorial triptych with three stacked cinematic frames. The subject is an adult woman with medium-length dark hair, natural makeup, an opaque fitted white top, and delicate gold jewelry for visual continuity. Frame 1 is emotional and introspective: she looks downward with a hand gently near the collarbone, with soft Rembrandt lighting sculpting cheekbones and bone structure. Frame 2 is a crisp profile portrait, gaze slightly upward, poised and confident. Frame 3 is a frontal thoughtful portrait with relaxed shoulders and direct eye contact, conveying quiet strength and elegance. Keep the composition clean and modern on a neutral studio background. Use commercial magazine quality from a high-end mirrorless camera, authentic skin texture, soft bokeh, and cinematic sophistication.
